notes: Card: '0' x6, '1' x6, ' don' x4, '-' x4, ' ' x3, ' such' x2, and many top windows are short, so this may be partly positional. Probes: ' isn' 0.917, ' weren' 0.916, ' don' 0.906; full forms 'There is no' and 'We were going' under 0.04. But ' ' before a year near the start also scored 0.866-0.877, whether 1998 or 2008, which this label does not cover. The fire items place the contraction past the sentence start to test the position question.
